verdict.rationale: Lever does publish a developer API reference with endpoint sections such as 'Create an application', 'List all audit events', OAuth and webhooks, plus partner 'example apps'. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or has runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. A static endpoint listing and separate example apps are adjacent to this story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
